info.title: Geoapify Geometry API
info.description: Store GeoJSON geometries and calculate unions or intersections of two or more reusable geometry or isoline IDs.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

tags.name: Geometry
tags.description: Store GeoJSON and combine stored or generated geometries by union or intersection.

get.summary: Combine geometries by union or intersection
get.description:
Combines two or more previously generated or stored geometries and returns a new GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

- Repeat the `id` query parameter for every input geometry; at least two IDs are required.
- Use `operation=union` to merge all covered areas, or `operation=intersection` to return only their common area.
- Input IDs can come from APIs that return reusable geometry or isoline IDs, or from `POST /geometry`.
- The default `format=geojson` response includes a new `properties.id` that can be reused in later Geometry API calls.
- `topojson` returns TopoJSON and `geobuf` returns a binary Geobuf payload.

**Example:** union two 600-second drive isolines near Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Geometry or isoline IDs to combine. Repeat `id` for every input; at least two IDs are required.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Required operation. `union` merges all input areas; `intersection` keeps only their common area.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Optional detail datasets to add to each returned feature.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response encoding. The documented response schema and example describe the default GeoJSON format.

200.description: Combined geometry. The example is the GeoJSON union of the two preset drive isolines.

400.description: Invalid geometry IDs, fewer than two IDs, unsupported operation, details, or response format.

value.message: "format" must be one of [geojson, topojson, geobuf]

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

post.summary: Store a GeoJSON geometry for later operations
post.description:
Stores a GeoJSON geometry and returns an ID for later Geometry API operations.

- Send a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature, or geometry object in the request body.
- Keep the returned `id` and pass it as one of the repeated `id` parameters in `GET /geometry`.
- Use the GET operation with at least two IDs to calculate a union or intersection.

requestBody.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature, or geometry to store.

200.description: Reusable identifier for the stored geometry.

400.description: Invalid JSON or GeoJSON request body.

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

id.description: Reusable identifier accepted by the GET operation.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the API gateway.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
